_about: Reference-table writer (reference/env-vars, serve-flags, config-classes, metrics). Only terms that no other glossary file defines.

environment-variable.short: A named text value that a process gets from its parent when it starts. vLLM declares its VLLM_* variables in vllm/envs.py.
environment-variable.long: Each variable is a function in the dict environment_variables ({{cite vllm/envs.py:618}}).

config-class.short: A pydantic dataclass in vllm/config/ made with the @config decorator. It forbids unknown fields. VllmConfig holds one object of each top-level config class.

prometheus-label.short: A key-value pair on a Prometheus metric, for example engine="0". Each set of label values is one time series.
prometheus-label.long: Most vLLM engine metrics use the labels model_name and engine ({{cite vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py:499}}).

prometheus-counter.short: A Prometheus metric that only goes up, for example the number of generated tokens. Use rate() to get a value per second.

prometheus-gauge.short: A Prometheus metric that holds the current value and can go up and down, for example the number of waiting requests.
